content:
Good afternoon. I previously contributed SimpleGraph.ball, and I'd like to continue in that lane.

In my (u,v)-flower formalization, I added a local Hom.dist_le to transfer distance bounds from smaller graphs to cells in larger ones. My proof that isomorphic graphs have equal box counts also repeats walk arguments through an isomorphism and its inverse.

I'm thinking of contributing Hom.edist_le, Hom.dist_le, Iso.edist_eq, and Iso.dist_eq in SimpleGraph/Metric.lean. Only Hom.dist_le would require the two vertices to be reachable in the source graph.

These would save that repeated work and also give ball-mapping corollaries: homomorphisms map balls into balls of the same radius around the mapped center, and isomorphisms map them onto those balls.

Would these be welcome as a small PR? Feedback is welcome, thank you.
Thanks @Snir Broshi, the PR is open and CI is passing. #44872
